segments.text:
V. 13.
Pilate ſat down on the Judgment ſeat—Which was then without the Palace, in a place called, in Greek, the pavement, on Account of a beautiful Piece of Moſaic Work, with which the Floor was adorned; but in Hebrew, Gabbatha—Or the High-Place, becauſe it ſtood on an Eminence, to that the Judge, ſitting on his Throne, might be ſeen and heard by a conſiderable Number of People.
